categories.finding: Prompts, tool cards and artifacts convey the workflow silently, but financial detail requires pausing and domain knowledge.
Blur, orange highlights and brackets guide attention from requests to changed outputs.
Multiple professional tasks fit into 103s. The handoff is clear, but the model logic and final recommendation are too compressed to audit.
The opening teaser becomes an input to a broader decision workflow; the memo completes that chain.
The steady artifact progression appears intended to suggest control and productivity; viewer effect unmeasured.
Horizon Health Group and the attached deck persist across the handoff, model and memo.
